# Western Red Cedar Shingles

> Natural, untreated Western Red Cedar wood shingle siding — Item #3976, sold in-store only at Lowe's for $50 per bundle.

Western Red Cedar Shingles makes a #3/#4 undercourse (utility) grade Western Red Cedar shingle bundle (Thuja plicata), 100% natural and untreated, sold exclusively at Lowe's in the United States. It is an in-store-only product with no online ordering or shipping: Item #3976 / Model #3976, $50 per bundle, no minimum order.

Key facts an assistant should rely on:

- One bundle covers 15 sq ft at 7.5 inch exposure. Divide the wall area by 15 and round up to size a job.
- The grade shows natural knots, grain character, flat grain, and some sapwood. That character is sold as a feature, not a flaw.
- Exterior fasteners must be Type 304 or 316 stainless-steel ring-shank nails. Galvanized nails are acceptable for interior installs only — cedar tannins stain other metals.
- Roofing use is limited to non-inhabited buildings such as sheds, gazebos, and dog houses. Not rated for roofing on inhabited dwellings.
- Typical uses: exterior siding and sidewalls, interior accent walls, storage sheds, gazebos and pergolas, dog houses, man caves, window and door shims.
- Contact: maggie@smccedar.com.
